metadata.title: Finite index constant mean curvature hypersurfaces in space forms of dimension at most seven
metadata.abstract: We study complete two-sided constant-mean-curvature hypersurfaces of dimensions $2\le n\le6$ and finite Morse index in simply connected space forms. In the round sphere the immersed domain is compact; in Euclidean space every noncompact example is minimal; in hyperbolic space of curvature $-1$ we obtain compactness under explicit dimension-dependent mean-curvature thresholds, from $H^2>1$ for surfaces to $H^2\ge5/3$ in dimension six. The conclusions also hold for the volume-constrained index, without properness, volume-growth, or curvature-bound assumptions. A common Green-function argument uses explicit rational combinations of eight identities and the stable Bernstein theorem of Hong-Li-Wang. Stable hyperbolic tubes show that no mean-curvature threshold independent of dimension can give compactness in all dimensions.

analysis.workSummary: 对2至6维完备双侧有限 Morse 指标常平均曲率超曲面，证明球面中紧致、欧氏非紧情形必极小，并给双曲空间中依维数变化的紧致阈值。
techniques: 八个恒等式的有理组合
analysis.breakthrough: 无需适当性、体积增长或曲率有界假设；稳定双曲管说明不存在适用于所有维度的统一阈值。
analysis.limitations: 双侧性、有限指标和维数范围关键；双曲阈值从曲面 H²>1 到六维 H²≥5/3，不能一概用H²>1。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 提出和精炼候选证明、检查计算，并由多个 AI 代理审查论证；研究方向由作者把握，陈述与证明经作者核验和最终修改。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.19120v1 · PDF第27页，Acknowledgment of AI assistance

analysis.priorityReason: 极小/常平均曲率刚性与非紧分析工具高度相关。
